description: This file defines the TraceModernizer class responsible for processing and modernizing trace events across different versions, handling trace data transformation, error handling, and maintaining internal state related to trace processing.

classes.name: TraceVersionError
classes.description: Custom error class for handling trace version incompatibility errors.

classes.name: TraceModernizer
classes.description: Main class responsible for processing, modernizing, and managing trace events across different versions.

methods.name: appendTrace
methods.description: Splits the trace string into lines and processes each event line.

methods.name: actions
methods.description: Returns an array of all ActionEntry objects collected.

methods.name: _pageEntry
methods.description: Retrieves or creates a PageEntry for a given pageId.

methods.name: _appendEvent
methods.description: Parses a JSON line into events and processes each event.

methods.name: _innerAppendEvent
methods.description: Processes individual trace events, updating internal state and handling different event types.

methods.name: _processedContextCreatedEvent
methods.description: Checks if a context-created event has been processed.

methods.name: _modernize
methods.description: Converts an event into a sequence of modernized trace events, applying version upgrades.

methods.name: _modernize_0_to_1
methods.description: Modernizes trace events from version 0 to version 1.

methods.name: _modernize_1_to_2
methods.description: Modernizes trace events from version 1 to version 2.

methods.name: _modernize_2_to_3
methods.description: Modernizes trace events from version 2 to version 3.

methods.name: _modernize_3_to_4
methods.description: Converts trace events from version 3 to version 4.

methods.name: _modernize_event_3_to_4
methods.description: Converts individual trace events from version 3 to 4, filtering internal events and handling console messages.

methods.name: _modernize_4_to_5
methods.description: Converts trace events from version 4 to version 5, handling JSHandle and console message args.

methods.name: _modernize_event_4_to_5
methods.description: Processes individual events from version 4 to 5, updating console objects and handling console messages.

methods.name: _modernize_5_to_6
methods.description: Converts trace events from version 5 to 6, adding log entries for 'after' events.

methods.name: _modernize_6_to_7
methods.description: Converts trace events from version 6 to 7, adding context options if missing and updating step IDs.

methods.name: _modernize_7_to_8
methods.description: Converts trace events from version 7 to 8, updating stepId and title fields.
